requirements.text: Professional experience building and deploying production-grade software, ideally including AI-powered or agentic systems
Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or another language commonly used to build AI applications, platforms, and developer tooling
Experience building or working with agent loops, including planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, and termination
Familiarity with graph-based orchestration, state machines, and multi-step workflows for coordinating agents, tools, data, and human approvals
Experience designing evaluation systems for AI applications, including task-based benchmarks, regression suites, model-graded evaluations, human review, and production monitoring
Understanding of the trade-offs involved in prompts, context management, memory, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and model selection
Experience instrumenting AI systems to trace decisions, inspect intermediate states, measure quality, and diagnose failures
Strong knowledge of APIs, distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern software-development practices
Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, technologies, and business domains
Ability to move from an ambiguous customer problem to a working prototype, validate with real users and evaluations, evolve to a secure maintainable production system
Strong product judgment and ability to balance model capability, reliability, latency, cost, security, and user experience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain AI-system behavior, limitations, risks, technical trade-offs clearly
Ability to travel occasionally for client workshops or on-site delivery, where required
Experience collaborating directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional delivery teams
